name: Considérant N - Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the illegal Türkiye-Libya Memorandum of Understanding and infringement of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea
part_text: N. whereas in July 2024, Türkiye deployed military ships in order to impede the Italian ship *Ievoli Relume* from conducting research for the construction of the Great Sea Interconnector, an electricity interconnection project between Greece and Cyprus and an EU Project of Common Interest, inside the Greek EEZ near Kassos, claiming jurisdiction under the pretext of the MoU; whereas Türkiye has repeatedly obstructed the EUR 2.1 billion EU-backed Great Sea Interconnector project, including by interrupting maritime operations in 2024; whereas the Great Sea Interconnector is a legitimate EU Project of Common Interest connecting two Member States, Greece and Cyprus, and is being implemented in full accordance with international law, including UNCLOS, without requiring any prior consent or notice of any form whatsoever from any non-EU country; whereas the Great Sea Interconnector route crosses maritime areas under Greece’s sovereign rights; whereas Türkiye unlawfully claims jurisdiction over Greece’s maritime areas under the pretext of the illegal MoU; whereas such claims are entirely baseless and have already caused concrete delays and disruptions to the project, undermining the rule of law, the sovereign rights of EU Member States and the EU’s energy security objectives; whereas following the deal, three months ago, making the French infrastructure investor Meridiam a majority shareholder in the project, a French vessel departed Heraklion to resume work on the project amid heightened concerns over potential Turkish interference;
